selected.rationale: Loss on basket-api->redis makes the basket backing store unreachable, causing all cart read/write operations to fail and exposing the lack of a fallback/retry or recovery path for this critical dependency.

Dropping the checkout message from basket-api->rabbitmq means the order is never created downstream while the user sees checkout succeed, exposing missing outbox/retry recovery and causing order inconsistency.
Delay on webapp->basket-api stalls every storefront cart action, and without a timeout/circuit-breaker the latency propagates unbounded to end users.
Delay on webapp->ordering-api slows order submission/history and can hold HTTP threads indefinitely, exposing missing timeout propagation on this service edge.
Delay on mobile-bff->ordering-api causes mobile orders to hang and can exhaust the BFF, exposing missing timeout controls for the mobile ordering flow.
Delay on basket-api->redis makes each basket operation block on a slow cache, quickly saturating Basket.API and exposing no effective client timeout or bounded retry.
Loss on webapp->ordering-api causes user requests to be silently dropped without client-visible error, exposing missing retry/idempotency defenses on the HTTP order edge.
Delay on webapp->identity-api blocks login and authentication flows, and without a timeout/breaker it can propagate latency to the whole web portal.
